description: Activate when: user says 'Pareto,' '80/20,' 'vital few,' 'long tail,' 'where is the leverage'; a team is treating many items as equally important; a backlog has no triage; growth efforts are spread thin across too many initiatives. Do NOT activate when: fewer than ~6 items total (no distribution to analyze); safety-critical or regulatory contexts where every item must be addressed regardless of frequency. More: deciqai.com/c/pareto-principle
